metadata.description: Claude Code mods and skills by PickleBoxer: rate limits and spend, git status, pasted image previews, poteto's pstack skills and the pickle workflow skills

plugins.name: burn
plugins.description: Rate limits, usage credits and spend above the prompt, with a /burn pane for the last 7 days

plugins.name: drift
plugins.description: Folder, branch, ahead/behind and uncommitted changes above the prompt, with a /drift pane for changes and branches

plugins.name: peek
plugins.description: Thumbnails above the prompt for every image you paste

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: poteto's rigorous engineering skills (poteto-mode, how/why, architect, verification), ported from Cursor, with a /poteto mode toggle and a /pstack skills pane

plugins.name: pickle
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills built on agent-skills, picked per task by /pickle:pickle-mode, with a welcome band and a /pickle-guide pane
